arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong hooks, cinematic mood, mainstream variation.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Start of high energy hook section

sound_intent.description: Sparse verses with strong, cinematic hooks incorporating characteristic phonk sample chopping and layering.

routing_intent.description: Each lane routed with separate bus channels named after sample chop techniques to emphasize texture and arrangement clarity.

track_roles.drums: Rhythm foundation with chopped and sliced sample hits emphasizing groove
track_roles.bass: Low-end support using chopped and looped bass samples
track_roles.chords: Textural layer with stuttered and reversed chord samples
track_roles.melody: Lead melodic elements built with granular and time-stretched chops
track_roles.vocal: Vocal chops and pitch-shifted samples providing hook hooks and texture
track_roles.fx: SFX layers using glitch and stutter chops to enhance transitions

designer_intent.goal: Create a mainstream phonk arrangement with cinematic mood, using sparse verses and energy-packed hooks with sample chop naming conventions.

presetor_intent.goal: Presets should enhance clarity and sample articulation to highlight chopped textures in the arrangement.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns emphasizing groove with sliced and chopped drum samples, maintaining sparse verse energy and dense hook fills.

bass_generator.brief: Create basslines using looped and sliced techniques, supporting hooks with punchy and clear low-end, sparser during verses.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chord textures applying stutter and reverse slicing to build cinematic atmosphere and dynamic movement.

melody_generator.brief: Develop melodic lines with granular and time-stretch chopping methods, keeping melody prominent in hooks and minimal in verses.

ai_designer.brief: Design overall arrangement flow balancing sparse verses and energetic hooks, adhering to cinematic mood and mainstream phonk style.

presetor.brief: Configure presets to suit chopped sampling techniques with clarity and dynamic presence for each lane.

songgps.brief: Manage the arrangement GPS routing and energy contour, ensuring sample chop based channel naming and dynamics.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix audio channels emphasizing clarity and spatial separation of chop techniques across drums, bass, chords, melody, vocal, and fx.
